messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: HIGH - cumulative packet loss detected from us-west-2 -> upstream provider (CarrierX) (alerts: net/packetloss/us-west-2). Auto-page sent to #incidents and on-call.

alex.k: I'm on it. seeing alerts for ~20% packet loss on several transit links out of us-west-2. Initial spike ~08:12 UTC.

maria-net: I can confirm BGP churn on the CarrierX sessions. Lots of withdraws and flapping prefixes. Looks like remote AS 64512 is toggling.

sam-sre: customer impact: synthetic p50 latency for API ingests up 3x, error rate for TCP handshakes up ~12% (TLS handshake fails). A subset of customers in us-west-2 and cross-region traffic is timing out.

jesse-inclead: OK. Triage plan: 1) gather BGP session state + prefixes, 2) route around with alternate transit (if possible), 3) post interim status to status page and comms. Maria, can you paste show bgp?

maria-net: Paste from edge-router-uw2-1:

```
BGP neighbor 203.0.113.5: Established
  Received prefixes: 12, Withdrawn: 42 (last 5m)
  Flap count: 18
BGP neighbor 203.0.113.6: Active -> Idle -> Connect (repeated)
  Last reset reason: TCP timeout
```

maria-net: Looks like one CarrierX peer is oscillating and withdrawing many announced /24s.

alex.k: Routing table snapshots show important customer prefixes briefly became unreachable, then got re-advertised via a suboptimal path through eu-west which is why latency skyrocketed for some flows.

lily-support: Heads-up: a couple enterprise customers are already on the phone, complaining about failed webhooks and ingestion timeouts. I opened support tickets: #INC-4982 and #INC-4983.

jesse-inclead: Good catch. Sam do we have percentage of traffic that got rerouted cross-region?

sam-sre: From telemetry: ~18% of traffic egressing us-west-2 for specific customers hit alternate peering paths between 08:12-08:34 UTC. Packet retransmits also increased. We're seeing ~40% packet loss on the affected CarrierX path during the peak window.

alex.k: Mitigation options: 1) Ask CarrierX to patch/fix their session (we've got a ticket), 2) Temporarily shift transit to ProviderY via our backup peering at edge-uw2-2 (we can push policy to prefer ProviderY for impacted prefixes), 3) Drain sessions and let traffic reconverge (risky). I recommend option 2 + carrier engagement.

maria-net: I'm prepping a BGP policy change. Will prep a limited prefix-set to only move impacted customer prefixes to ProviderY to reduce blast radius. Posting planned commands in 2m.

carrierx-noc: (from CarrierX) We see interface errors on our aggregation node in SJC cluster, investigating hardware flapping. We have a ticket CW-9123. ETA unknown right now.

jesse-inclead: Thanks. Sam please draft a brief incident summary for status page (interim), include affected scope and mitigation steps. Keep it short: region, impact, ETA unknown, working with provider and applying temporary routing.

sam-sre: Drafting: "Interim: We are investigating increased packet loss and intermittent routing instability affecting some customers in us-west-2. Traffic is being rerouted through alternate paths causing elevated latency and some failed connections. We are actively working with our upstream provider (CarrierX) and have applied temporary routing adjustments to mitigate impact. No ETA yet." Thoughts?

lily-support: Add note about specific symptoms for customers: webhook retries, upload timeouts, and higher latencies. Also include links to support tickets.

sam-sre: Updated draft includes symptoms + link to support queue. Posting now. status-bot: Posted interim update to status.redwood.ai/incidents/PRD-311.

maria-net: Ready to apply the limited policy. Plan: on edge-uw2-2 set local-preference +200 for prefix-set IMPACTED-PRFX, announced to ProviderY only. Commands:

```
route-map RM-IMP set local-preference 200
ip prefix-list IMPACTED-PRFX permit 198.51.100.0/24
neighbor 198.51.100.10 route-map RM-IMP in
```

alex.k: I'll coordinate the ACL and BGP policy push. Maria, apply in staging then prod edge-uw2-2. Notify before commit.

maria-net: Applying in 30s to staging (edge-uw2-2-stg) -> looks good. Pushing to prod now.

alex.k: Pushed. Watching traffic.

sam-sre: Telemetry: after policy push at 08:28 UTC, packet loss on affected prefixes drops from ~40% -> ~6% within two minutes. Latency p50 drops back to ~normal for most affected customers. Error rate decreases.

lily-support: One customer still seeing failures, looks like their upstream provider is pinned to CarrierX path specifically; retesting with customer support.

jesse-inclead: Good mitigation. Next steps: 1) Keep ProviderY preference in place until CarrierX NOC confirms repair, 2) request root cause from CarrierX, 3) prepare postmortem. I'll hand off to next on-call at 10:00 UTC (nina).

nina-oncall: I'm taking the handoff at 10:00. Can someone summarize what remains open and the proposed follow-ups?

jesse-inclead: Handoff summary (copy): Impact: intermittent packet loss and BGP withdraws from CarrierX causing reroutes and elevated latency for customers in us-west-2. Mitigation: temporary routing preference to ProviderY for impacted prefixes applied at 08:28 UTC; telemetry shows meaningful improvement but a small fraction are still affected. Ongoing: CarrierX NOC investigating hardware flap; we asked for RCA and ETA. Action items: keep routing policy in place until confirmed; correlate L4 failed sessions to customer tickets; run postmortem once CarrierX provides root cause.

nina-oncall: Thanks. I'll own follow-ups. Will keep the policy in place and monitor for 4 hours, then reassess. Adding myself to the incident doc and will schedule a 1hr follow-up postmortem invite.

carrierx-noc: Update: We replaced the faulty linecard in SJC-agg1 at 09:40 UTC and sessions stabilized. We'll provide an incident report within 48hrs.

sam-sre: Verified: BGP flap count reduced to normal, packet loss normalized across the board by 09:42 UTC. No additional customer reports since 09:50.

jesse-inclead: Great. Status update: Incident mitigated at 09:42 UTC. Will keep status page entry open until postmortem. Thanks all for quick turn. :white_check_mark:

lily-support: Closing the two open customer calls. Adding notes to both support tickets with mitigation summary.

nina-oncall: I'll draft the postmortem template and tag Maria/Alex/Sam for technical write-up. Closing handoff complete.

status-bot: Incident marked as mitigated in status page (PRD-311). Final update will be posted after postmortem.

jesse-inclead: Closing thread here — creating follow-up doc in /incidents/postmortems once CarrierX RCA is available. Thanks everyone."
